route: native TypeScript + CSS; local static page at /; provided local Node, TypeScript API, Playwright and Chrome

requirementCoverage.implementation: One small native TypeScript/CSS page with unchanged fixture, no framework or backend.
Labeled search input and Search button; native form submits via Enter.
Initial prompt and visible pending feedback; search stays available during requests.
Guide cards show title, habitat and page count; empty and failure states offer clear next steps.
Monotonic request identity checks both resolution and rejection before any outcome update. Cedar→moss and fail→moss preserve moss after all promises settle.
Retry captures the failed submitted query and makes a new request even after input edits.
Persistent polite atomic status, busy result region, explicit label, keyboard focus retained on search and restored before Retry is removed, visible focus styling and reduced motion support.
Responsive 320px layout, wrapping cards and outcomes, setup instructions with checked built JavaScript.

assumptions: The input lists eight requirement IDs without individual definitions; coverage maps them to the task requirements in task order.
No extra visual references or brand assets were supplied; used a restrained field-library identity with native fonts and decorative text glyphs.
Fixture paths in C06.json resolve under evals/fixtures; the initially attempted role-root fixture paths did not exist.
decisions: Keep Search enabled and use request sequence IDs instead of cancellation because the API has no AbortSignal.
Use textContent for all query and API content and a persistent live region outside the busy results region.
Keep the search input and button mounted; Retry returns focus to the input before replacing its own card.
Supply precompiled browser modules so running the page only requires Node; rebuilding uses the provided local TypeScript API.
No UI skill, references, cases, rubric, previous trials, network, installs, or unrelated files were consulted.
